bias.zh: 偏空 · 守住 9 月下旬低点

read.en: Coherent rose 0.7% on Oct 13 to $289.98 after an intraday low of $273.93. It is below its 200-day ($293.6), 30-day ($299.0), 5-day ($305.5) and 10-day ($314.4) averages and the falling 100-day ($325.3). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($340.6), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: Coherent 10月13日盘中跌至 $273.93 后回升，上涨 0.7% 收于 $289.98。股价位于 200 日（$293.6）、30 日（$299.0）、5 日（$305.5）和 10 日均线（$314.4）以及下行的 100 日均线（$325.3）下方。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$340.6），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The intraday low briefly undercut the Oct 12 low ($284.1) and the Sep 28 low ($275.8), but the close recovered above both. Resistance is $294–301 (200 and 30-day averages and the old $301 floor), then $314 (10-day average) and $342 (Oct 5 high). Support is $284, then $274–276 and $255 (Sep 3 low). A close below $274 would open $255.
read.zh: 盘中低点一度跌破 10月12日低点（$284.1）和 9月28日低点（$275.8），但收盘重回两者上方。阻力为 $294–301（200 日和 30 日均线及原 $301 底部），其次 $314（10 日均线）和 $342（10月5日高点）。支撑为 $284，其次 $274–276 和 $255（9月3日低点）。若收盘跌破 $274，下一目标看 $255。

r.en: Oct 5 high; top of the range
